testcase.description: BIR51 FS — HKFRS for Private Entities (FS-PE Taxonomy)

variation.name: bir51_fs_pe_baseline
variation.description: A valid financial statements iXBRL data file for a BIR51 (corporation) filing prepared under HKFRS for Private Entities or SME-FRF & SME-FRS, using the IRD FS-PE Taxonomy. Mandatory FS items are the same as the full HKFRS path (Revenue, ProfitLossBeforeTax, TotalEquity) but the entry point and element namespace differ.
